title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Contextual nudges on address bar offering help summarizing webpages.
description: Microsoft Edge for Business plans to introduce an easy way for users to get summaries of their open page from the address bar using Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. This feature seeks to help users more easily understand relevant content and save time.
